seoTitle: How to Connect a Namecheap Domain to Google Workspace
metaDescription: Learn how to connect your Namecheap domain to Google Workspace and get your website and business email live under your own domain in 2026.
intro: If your domain is registered with Namecheap and you want to use it with Google Workspace for email and a website, the two need to be linked through your DNS settings. This guide walks through connecting them step by step.

steps.heading: Set up your Google Workspace account
steps.body: Sign up for Workspace and enter your Namecheap domain name during setup so Google knows which domain to associate with your account.

steps.heading: Verify domain ownership
steps.body: Google provides a verification code or DNS record that you'll add in your Namecheap account to prove you control the domain.

steps.heading: Update DNS records in Namecheap
steps.body: Log in to Namecheap and add the required MX and verification records under the domain's Advanced DNS settings so Workspace services connect properly.

steps.heading: Add your website to Google Workspace
steps.body: Once the domain is verified, connect it to your website hosting or Google Sites setup so your site is reachable under the same domain.

steps.heading: Confirm everything is working
steps.body: Test that email delivery and your website both resolve correctly under the Namecheap domain before considering the setup complete.

faq.question: Do I need to transfer my domain from Namecheap to Google?
faq.answer: No, you can keep your domain registered with Namecheap and simply point the necessary DNS records to Google Workspace.

faq.question: How long does it take for DNS changes to take effect?
faq.answer: DNS propagation can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 48 hours, so allow some time before troubleshooting if things aren't working immediately.

faq.question: Can I use Namecheap's hosting alongside Google Workspace email?
faq.answer: Yes, you can keep your website hosted elsewhere while using Google Workspace strictly for email, as long as the DNS records are set correctly for each service.

faq.question: What if verification fails in Google Workspace?
faq.answer: Double-check that the exact verification record was added in Namecheap's DNS settings and give it time to propagate before trying again.
